page.layout: One column of names, one line per name, grouped by year. Left margin: the years 1592 to 1598. Right margin: short notes beside each year group. Printed page number 47 at the head.

page.notes: Left margin year 1598 is partly cut off and read as 1598 with doubt. Long s read as plain s throughout (e.g. Hispanicis, sustentata, Wisering). Printed "Ei & agro" in the 1594 note: the first word is unclear. Right-margin notes are set in smaller type and are placed at the line of their year group. Names are set in italic type.
